slides.title: 3 Himachal villages that feel like another planet
slides.body: swipe for the ones that made me forget what day it was

slides.title: Kalpa
slides.body: Wake up to the Kinnaur Kailash range turning gold, right from your window.
Stay up in old Kalpa, and walk to Roghi for the viewpoint they call ‘Suicide Point’.

slides.title: Chitkul
slides.body: the last inhabited village before the Indo–Tibet border
The cleanest air I’ve ever breathed, and a silence that makes you forget your phone exists.
Eat at the last dhaba of Hindustan, and come May–October, before the snow shuts the road.

slides.title: Tosh
slides.body: where Parvati valley simply runs out of road
Slow mornings, chai with a snow-peak view, and nowhere you have to be.
